      • randomString

        public static java.lang.String randomString(int len,
                                            java.util.HashMap<java.lang.Character,java.lang.Double> freq)
        Creates a random string of the given length using an alphabet whose symbols have an associated probability. Symbols will appear in the string with these probabilities. If the probabilities provided do not add up to 1.0, they will be normalized to do so.
        Parameters:
        len - the length of the string
        freq - the frequencies of symbols in the alphabet
        Returns:
        a string of the given length and alphabet
